value.rationale: Full-completion time and its Gaussian fluctuations are natural quantitative performance invariants for the precise synchronous matching rule. The motivating 2026 paper explicitly asks about other graph densities and the endgame. The complete-graph calculation supplies a rigorous exact first-order time constant and variance constant in a regime not covered by its sparse-graph theorem, and the linear matching time contrasts structurally with the polylogarithmic rounds required to match a fixed fraction in the sparse setting.
